sentences.text: Black Ocean Media Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-27 under the industry code 73112, other activities of advertising agencies.
A start-up notification and a board change were both registered on 2026-10-02.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
